reason: I already keep my spending in a Google Sheet and I don't want to switch to a new app. The slip capture only helps if I remember to scan every transfer, and I know I won't do that every day.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the app is half-empty and I'm back to my spreadsheet.
would_change_my_mind: If it imported my existing Google Sheet or Excel file and kept it in sync, so I didn't have to scan slips at all.
